questions.question: It was the staff who had been working late that were responsible for the mess in the office.
options: It was the staff's work that had caused the mess.
The staff who worked late were responsible for the mess.
The staff had been working late, and it was they who were responsible for the mess.
The staff who had been working late were the ones responsible for the mess.
questions.answer: The staff who worked late were responsible for the mess.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, it had already been decided that the project would be delayed.
options: When I arrived, they had decided to delay the project.
I was told that the project would be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
The decision to delay the project had been made before my arrival.
By the time I arrived, it was clear that the project would not meet its deadline.
questions.answer: The decision to delay the project had been made before my arrival.

questions.question: Had he studied harder, he might have passed the exam.
options: If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.
He would have passed the exam if only he had studied harder.
He didn't study hard enough to pass the exam.
It's unlikely that he would have passed the exam even with more studying.
questions.answer: If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.

questions.question: The report stressed that it was essential for all employees to be aware of the new policy.

It was crucial that employees were made aware of the new policy, as stated in the report.
The report highlighted the need for transparency regarding the new policy.

questions.answer: It was crucial that employees were made aware of the new policy, as stated in the report.
